name: Current primary experimental object definition v1
scope: Overhead dairy-cattle corridor with torso labels consistent with OpenCows2020 definition
box_extent: Torso; source paper excludes head, neck, legs and tail. Preserve source-provided labels and document inconsistencies rather than inventing a whole-cow target.
passage_point: Centre of the tracked torso box for model output; independent event review must apply the declared body-reference definition, not copy model events
identity_crop: Native-resolution torso-region evidence; temporary track ID distinct from enrolled cattle identity
external_Toros: Frozen counting diagnostic retained. Publisher boxes seen include head/legs; box-IoU comparison has extent mismatch and is not same-target AP validation.
data_split_gate: Byte-duplicate groups isolated in current development split; augmented parent/capture-session relationship remains incomplete. Future final validation must bind independent sessions or another suitable dataset.
future_real_vs_mixed_control: Match optimiser updates, augmentation policy, initialisation, batch size and seeds; record sampling exposure. Use only training body-box labels, not source-video pseudo-labels.
